title: Three-Shape Order · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three-Shape Order · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws three simple shapes in a row and covers them after a brief look. The lead draws the shapes from memory in the original order. All three shapes and their order match. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three-Shape Order, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All three shapes and their order match.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All three shapes and their order match.
